name: arhun-plugins
description: Arhun Saday's Claude Code plugins: mods, skills, commands, agents and hooks.

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Holds destructive commands (rm -r, force pushes, git resets and cleans, branch deletes, migrations, SQL drops) and shows what they would destroy

plugins.name: context-cache
plugins.description: Context usage, usage limits and prompt-cache warmth above the prompt, drawn in your theme; collapses to one line

plugins.name: plan-progress
plugins.description: Live plan progress bars above the Claude Code prompt: stages, steps, foldable agent strips and soft sounds

plugins.name: where-am-i
plugins.description: A live recap above the prompt: goal, what Claude is doing now, next step and what waits on you
